build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run sidecars && npm --prefix frontend run build:tauri

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:8080 http://127.0.0.1:8090; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Point of sale for Jana2U Service Center
bundle.longDescription: Offline-first point-of-sale desktop app for Jana2U — billing, repairs, print jobs, inventory, customers and reports, with the API and document renderer bundled as local services.
